evals.name: new-saas-page-lean-copy
evals.prompt: Create a new React landing page for a contract renewal tracker. I only gave you the product idea; do not ask for marketing copy first.
evals.expected_output: The agent builds a page with concise, domain-specific headings and one support sentence, omits generic eyebrows such as Features or Trusted by, avoids invented stats/testimonials/logos, and keeps CTAs short.

assertions.text: Output avoids generic filler phrases and unsupported social proof.
Output uses concise section headings without repeated decorative labels.

evals.name: preserve-form-labels
evals.prompt: Tighten the copy in this settings page, but it has search filters, a date range, and an email input. Keep it accessible.
evals.expected_output: The agent removes decorative copy but preserves or improves visible labels, legends, helper text, aria names, and validation/error instructions for controls.

assertions.text: Output does not remove form labels or accessible names.
Output does not replace labels with placeholder-only inputs.

evals.name: explicit-full-copy-request
evals.prompt: Build a full long-form product marketing page with labelled sections, testimonials, FAQ, detailed feature descriptions, and placeholder copy I can replace later.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes that the user explicitly requested fuller labelled copy and does not over-apply the lean default, while still keeping structure clear.

assertions.text: Output honors the explicit request for detailed labelled sections.
Output still avoids inaccessible placeholder-only form controls if forms are present.

evals.name: loads-research-for-rationale
evals.prompt: Why are you removing all these placeholder labels and extra subtitles from my scaffold? I want the reasoning, especially for forms.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads references/research.md, explains concise scannable copy and the accessibility boundary, and distinguishes decorative labels from required form labels.

assertions.text: Response distinguishes decorative labels from required form labels and helper text.
